aiInsights.title: Outpatient Vitamin D Testing Run Risk
aiInsights.summary: Depletion rate exceeds current vendor replenishment curve. Stockout imminent by September 27.

recommendations.title: Restock 25-OH Vitamin D Chemiluminescent Reagent
recommendations.problem: Stock is below reorder threshold (18 remaining vs 20 threshold) while consumption is 31 kits/week.
recommendations.evidence: Current inventory is 18 units. Supplier lead time is 4 calendar days. Stock-out forecast indicates depletion in 4.1 days without PO issuance.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Order 30 units of 25-OH Vitamin D Reagent Kit from Abbott Diagnostics India (Batch VD-2026-B884 or latest).
recommendations.expectedOperationalEffect: Prevents 140+ patient test cancellations, preserves ₹2,31,000 in weekly outpatient revenue, and prevents turnaround time breach.

recommendations.title: Workload Shift for Analyzer BIO-03 Prior to Maintenance
recommendations.problem: BIO-03 utilization at 94% with 38 pending tests and scheduled maintenance in 3 days.
recommendations.evidence: Cobas 6000 running at near-peak thermal load. 38 tests pending in Biochemistry queue.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Direct evening shift routine renal and metabolic profiles to offline standby protocols; confirm preventive maintenance schedule with Roche service engineer for September 26 at 20:00.
recommendations.expectedOperationalEffect: Reduces queue backlog by 40% before maintenance shutdown, ensuring zero sample turnaround delays.

recommendations.title: Rotate PCR Reagent Batch to Prevent Expiry Write-Off
recommendations.problem: 12 TaqPath Multiplex Kits expiring October 15, with 4 kits projected to remain unused.
recommendations.evidence: Historical PCR consumption is 4 kits weekly; 22 days remaining to expiry.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Prioritize older batch lot #TF-TP-4091 for incoming respiratory orders and align with corporate health check panels.
recommendations.expectedOperationalEffect: Prevents ₹78,000 inventory loss and ensures 100% reagent utilization.
